Appropriation and Honoraria.
Adecuate funds
shall be appropriated annually from any funds in the National
Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the operation and
maintenance of the Council for the Welfare of children.
The members and the Chairman of the Council and members of
committees; sectoral panels, and task forces that may be created
by the Council shall receive honoraria for every meeting actually
attended the amount of which shall be determined by an
appropriate Council resolution and authorized by the Department
of Budget and Management.
New Structure and Pattern. Upon approval of this
Executive Order, the officers and employees of the Council shall,
in a hold-over capacity, continue to perform their respective
duties and responsibilities and receive the corresponding
salaries and benefits.
* The new position structure and staffing pattern by the
Council shall be approved by the Secretary of the Department of

authorized positions created thereunder shall be filled with

Those incumbents whose positions are not included therein or
who are not reappointed shall be deemed separated from the
Those separated from the service shall receive the
retirement benefits to which they may be entitled under existing
laws, rules, and regulations. Otherwise, they shall be paid the
ecruivalent of one (1) month basic salary for every year of
service or the equivalent nearest fraction there favorable to
them on the basis of the highest salary received, but in no case
shall such payment exceed the equivalent of 12 months salary.
